messages:
liz: Quick idea 1: launch a 3-piece community push: 2 hands-on tutorials, a short benchmark writeup, and a live "mini-webinar" (30m) tied to an OSS refapp. Goal: product signups + repo stars.

kevin: Sounds good. I can draft the blog launch and the short social thread. We should keep the tutorial code tiny so contributors can run locally in <10 minutes.

neha: Ill run the content calendar. Proposed cadence: announce -> tutorial A -> tutorial B + bench teaser -> webinar + final bench. 4 weeks total.

tom: DevRel will assemble the repo and a reproducible bench script. Plan: 3 model configs (default, quantized, cache-enabled) and a small set of prompts. Will include Docker for reproducibility.

liz: For routing: webinar RSVPs -> tag by "Company size" and "Primary use case" on the form. Enterprise leads go to SDR; smaller orgs get auto nurture + trial invite. Can we auto-populate CRMs?

kevin: Yes 1. UTM plan: utm_source=refapp_miniseries&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=ignite_refapp&utm_content={channel}. Use same pattern across social/email.

neha: I'll wire the form. Suggest 2 gating fields: "Company size" (dropdown) and "Are you evaluating inference infra?" (yes/no). That should be enough to route.

tom: Repo snippet for README: ```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/ignite-refapp.git
cd ignite-refapp
docker build -t ignite-refapp .
docker run --rm -e MODEL=small ignite-refapp ./bench.sh --iters 50
```
I'll add a smoke CI to validate the docker build on PRs.

kevin: Draft headlines: "Ship a tiny refapp that scales inference" or "From zero to running inference: a 30-minute refapp" 1. I prefer the second for motion.

liz: Second works. Messaging note: emphasize low friction + reproducible bench numbers. One social variant should tease a surprising perf stat to drive clicks.

neha: Ops notes: webinar needs landing page, short bio for speakers, and a CTA to the repo. I'll set webinar capacity at 200 and record for on-demand.

marketing-bot: Template reminder: webinar checklist created -> https://docs.internal/redwood/templates/webinar-mini-checklist (auto-post)

kevin: Action items: I'll post blog draft + 3 social variants by Tue.
tom: I'll open the repo and PR the CI by EOD Friday.
neha: I'll share the landing page mock and form fields Wed.
liz: I'll finalize routing rules and kickoff SDR sequence.

liz: Please react with :white_check_mark: to accept ownership. Thanks! :sparkles:

kevin: :white_check_mark:

tom: :white_check_mark:

neha: :white_check_mark:

liz: Great. I'll create the Asana epic and tag everyone.
